d356af7bdafd297e.title: glaive
d356af7bdafd297e.desc: 16-year-old glaive is an artist hailing from the mountains of North Carolina who began making music at the beginning of the Covid-19 pandemic. He released his first song on Soundcloud in April and his rise in the time since has been meteoric, supported by a steady stream of new music that quickly earned him acclaim and a devoted following. He shared his debut EP cypress grove this past fall, with The FADER naming the single "astrid" one of the best song songs of 2020 and The New York Times' Jon Caramanica including it among his top tracks of the year. He shared his second, all dogs go to heaven, in August, with The New Yorker praising its "startlingly well-formed sound" and Rolling Stone citing standout single "detest me" as "a good example of everything there is to like about glaive." He now has 1,015,391 monthly listeners on Spotify -- a 101,539,100% increase after starting 2020 with just one.

d3b96ea0b026c731.title: A Great Day in the Stoke Surf Competition & Beach Festival
d3b96ea0b026c731.desc: Hang 10 on 10/10 as the A Great Day in the Stoke Presented by Lexus (AGDITS) returns for its fifth annual celebration of Black surf culture! Join presenting Sponsor Lexus, lululemon and Complex and other major brands to spotlight global Black surf talent, promote connection, water safety and health & wellness. This free, all-day event brings surf, music and community to Surf City USA in Huntington Beach. Watch world-class Black surfers compete in the Grom, men’s and women’s shortboard and longboard divisions, and new to 2026 – a 40+ Legends division. Competitors will include five-time AGDITS champion Julian Williams, who made history as the first Black Hawaiian to compete in the World Surf League Challenger Series at the US Open of Surfing last year. Enjoy live music from We the Commas, free surf lessons for kids, teens and adults (pre-sign up required) or enjoy the fan-favorite Double Dutch Contest. Don’t miss out on the Stoked at Sunrise 5K and Beach Yoga & Wellness Zone - both powered by lululemon for some seaside zen. More than just a competition, AGDITS is a vibrant celebration of culture and connection. For updates, follow @agreatdayinthestoke on Instagram or visit…
